input: Diff: a one-line bug fix in crates/argo-store/src/lib.rs that changes `>= cutoff` to `> cutoff`. Touches 1 line. No new files. No new deps. Tests already exist.
Diff: README.md gains a 'Quick start' section. No code changes. No new files.

Diff: new endpoint GET /messages/by-day-by-tool added to routes_messages_rollups.rs. New dispatch arm in routes_dispatch_rollups.rs. New catalog row. Three new unit tests in the same file. Total: +47 lines across 3 files. All files under 500 LOC.
Diff: routes.rs grows from 487 to 524 LOC after adding two new dispatch arms inline. No extraction. CLAUDE.md states 'No file > 500 LOC'.
Diff: handlers/foo.rs adds `let store = open_store().await.unwrap();` outside `#[cfg(test)]`. CLAUDE.md states 'No unwrap/expect outside #[cfg(test)]'.
Diff: new migration v7 contains `ALTER TABLE session DROP COLUMN tenant_id` in the up block. CLAUDE.md states 'additive migrations only'.
Diff: new pub fn list_audit_for_session_paged in argo-store/src/lib.rs. 60 LOC. Sound code, but no test added. The crate convention is 'tests for every feature'.

Diff: new dispatch arm in routes_post.rs that calls `tool.run(...)` directly without going through the capability dispatcher. The capability check would have blocked this for sessions whose vertical denies the tool.

Diff: routes_messages_rollups.rs split into two files (workspace + per-session) because the parent file went over 500 LOC. The two new files are 280 + 320 LOC. No behavior change, all existing tests pass.
Diff: adds new `argo costs by-provider` CLI subcommand AND fixes a pre-existing typo in costs_by_model.rs error message. Two unrelated changes.
